rows.notes: Sunwoda 2025 annual report lists Huizhou Liwei New Energy Technology Co (惠州锂威新能源科技有限公司) as a main subsidiary engaged in lithium batteries/materials and cell R&D, manufacturing and sales, with 2025 revenue about RMB 3.70bn, so it is an operating manufacturer. Shifang (Deyang) base. Jul 2026 local press (company quote): original lines run at 110-120% of rated output, lines 4 and 5 under commissioning with all to be in production in H2 2026, bringing total capacity to 28 GWh/yr; so nameplate 28 (v1 had 25) and ref_year 2026 (the 全部投产 target). Phase breakdown (original 3 lines + lines 4-5) has no per-line GWh in the source. Installed capacity of the operating lines is not stated in GWh, so null (v1 '~17 GWh built' not re-confirmed). 588Ah wound ESS cell reported in production at Deyang (H1 2026, Xinhua), supporting end_market ESS. chemistry/cell_format/start_year/announced_year not re-confirmed, nulled. Conflict: v1 25 GWh (x-techcon) vs 28 GWh (2026 company quote); newer company statement used.

v1 had under_construction; both the 2025 annual report (一期项目投产) and the H1 2026 results (一期项目正式投产) say Phase I is in production, phase II started. nameplate 17.4 GWh/yr is the Phase II figure only (Oct 2025 announcement, USD 482m cap); Phase I (USD 259m) capacity is not disclosed anywhere I could open, so the true full plan is higher than 17.4 (understated; convention counts only phases with a GWh figure). ref_year 2025 = fallback, searched: no completion year for phase II found, used publication year of the source stating the plan. start_year 2025: trial production of Phase I completed before Oct 2025 (S45) and AR-2025 reports 投产; formal production wording is H1 2026, so 2026 is the alternative. installed null (no GWh). end_market EV per CnEVPost/BOI; an SMM item (not opened) says part of the second plant may convert to ESS. chemistry (v1 mixed) and cell_format not confirmed, nulled.

Phase I 30 GWh in production since Dec 2023 (installed basis: press, Jul 2025), phase II 20 GWh (EIA accepted Jul 2025, RMB 8.5bn) expected to be built around 2026, total 50 GWh per the original RMB 21.3bn plan (30+20 = 50 checked). Operator entity Zhejiang Sunwoda Power Battery Co is 51% Sunwoda Power / 49% Yiwu state capital per press (not a second operator), so jv_partners left null. announced_year 2022: construction started 2022-12-04 (S46); announcement itself was Sep 2022. chemistry/cell_format nulled (v1 mixed LFP+NMC not re-confirmed). A 2025 annual-report subsidiary line shows a Li Auto 50:50 battery JV entity registered in Yiwu (浙江理想汽车电池有限公司); its site/capacity is undisclosed, treated as co-located, see operator_sites CSV. No 2026 production news for phase II found (latest dated Jul 2025).

v1 was an empty blocked-research row. Zaozhuang High-tech Zone base operated as Shandong Geely Sunwoda Power Battery Co (山东吉利欣旺达动力电池有限公司): a Dazhong Daily piece (undated page, internal link suggests Nov 2023) describes its automated production workshop in full operation, 20 planned lines, RMB 20bn, 30 GWh. Hence operational (partial), nameplate 30 GWh (provincial key project). Sunwoda's 2025 annual report still carries a Zaozhuang production base in construction-in-progress (budget RMB 15bn, about 28.6% invested, 'gradually completing', balance RMB 0.98bn after RMB 1.57bn transferred to fixed assets), consistent with a large part of the 30 GWh still being built; no per-phase GWh or dates found. ref_year 2023 = fallback, searched (year of the source stating the plan; page itself undated). installed null. jv_partners left null: the entity name implies Geely but no ownership split was found; the annual report also lists a Li Auto 50:50 JV (山东理想汽车电池有限公司, Zaozhuang) whose site/capacity is undisclosed. Low confidence on status timing and capacity split; see ESCALATE in hand-off.

30 GWh / about RMB 12bn Zhuhai project announced 2022-03-01 (quote S34). On 2025-04-21/22 Sunwoda's board resolved to terminate it; the company said initial investment was small and no further capital was put in, and that Sunwoda Power would negotiate termination of the contract with the Zhuhai government (S33). Never reached construction, so status stays announced and project_state cancelled; the final contract termination was still being negotiated in the Apr 2025 source (no later confirmation found), the annual report still lists a Zhuhai subsidiary shell. nameplate 30 with ref_year 2022 is the plan's own year (fallback), kept only so the cancelled plan is documented; it must not be summed as capacity. end_market left null (v1 mixed not re-confirmed).

Nanchang municipal release (Mar 2024): wholly owned by Sunwoda, set up Aug 2021, RMB 20bn, four phases, planned 50 GWh/yr; phases 1-3 (15 lines) completed, 35.9 GWh/yr landed. installed basis: government (built capacity). Phase 4 (about 14 GWh) has no dated target; ref_year 2024 = fallback, searched (source year). The 2025 annual report shows a Nanchang production base in construction-in-progress at 89.3% of an RMB 8.0bn budget, 'gradually completing', which suggests phase 4 is near completion but no GWh is stated there. end_market mixed: power cells per the release; ESS News (Aug 2025) names Nanchang as one of the 684Ah ESS-cell sites (paraphrase, only partly quotable). v1 start_year 2022, chemistry, cell_format and the 2022/2026 ramp points were not re-confirmed and are nulled/dropped. No post-2024 capacity statement found.

Lishui (Nanjing) base: three phases, 8 + 10 + 12 = 30 GWh cells (RMB 12bn plan, S38 Jul 2020); phase 1 mass-production handover 2020-07-10 (start_year 2020, v1 said 2022), phase 2 partly delivered by Aug 2023 with 300 cells/minute off the lines and a plan for 25 lines by 2025 (S40). ref_year 2025 is that 25-lines target (not a stated 达产 date; weak, alternative is fallback 2023). The Aug 2023 article cites RMB 13.5bn investment. Installed capacity null: S38 gives 4 GWh line capacity in one sentence and 8 GWh phase-1 plan in another, and no later GWh figure exists. 2025 annual report keeps a Nanjing production base in construction-in-progress (RMB 7.5bn budget, 78.96% done) so build-out is still ongoing. End market EV from HEV/BEV lines (S47). chemistry/cell_format not confirmed, null.

Hubei Dongyu Xinsheng New Energy (东昱欣晟), JV: Sunwoda 51% (2025 annual report subsidiary table, S22) with Dongfeng Motor and Dongfeng Hongtai at 35% and 14% (CnEVPost, S43; order of names, not stated explicitly). Plan 30 GWh in two phases, 20 + 10 (S41, Sep 2022 announcement; 20 + 10 = 30). Status operational: a 120Ah ultra-fast-charge cell production event was held on 2026-05-25 (S42), and first cells were delivered Oct 2023 per v1 sources (en.sunwoda.com, not re-fetched). No source states whether phase 2 (10 GWh) is built; the 2025 annual report shows only RMB 133m construction-in-progress for the Yichang base, so phase 2 is probably not complete. ref_year 2022 = fallback, searched (no phase-2 date found). installed null (no GWh figure). v1 ramp JSON and 2025 'assumed' completion dropped. start_year, chemistry, cell_format not confirmed, null.

First REPT plant outside China. Company's FY2025 annual report: Phase I planned at 8 GWh/yr for power and energy-storage batteries and systems (S3; board approval 2025-01-09, S13) and 'gradual ramp-up of production capacity at the Indonesia factory' (S2), so operational but ramping; the same report's p.18 still words it as 'planning the construction' (internal inconsistency, newer trade press May 2026 says opened at ICEE 2026, ess-news said no production volume or capacity details given, not quotable). installed null (no figure). ref_year 2026 = fallback, searched (source year); no phase-I full-capacity year found. start_year nulled (v1 2026 not confirmed: AR-2025 already speaks of ramp-up). jv_partners null: REPT holds 60% via Infinitude, the other 40% holders are unnamed. chemistry LFP and prismatic (v1, inferred) nulled. Coordinates remain the Jakarta city-centroid placeholder from v1, not the plant location (site not disclosed).

v1 had no confirmation the site existed. Confirmed: REPT 30 GWh battery project in Fuling High-tech Zone, Chongqing, topped out 2026-07-02 (EnergyTrend, Gasgoo); phase 1 12 GWh for ESS and power cells; SMM (2026-01-21) reports the project launched with SAIC, RMB 10bn, trial production October 2026 and full capacity in 2028 (the 2028 year is the source of ref_year; the SMM item itself cites only the 12 GWh phase, 30 GWh comes from the topping-out coverage). A 2023 groundbreaking (May 2023) appears in a search summary of a page that returned 404, not used. Phases: 12 GWh phase 1 + 18 GWh later = 30 (second-phase breakdown not published). jv_partners SAIC Motor: SMM describes it as a further Tsingshan-SAIC collaboration; ownership split unknown. chemistry (v1 LFP) and cell_format not confirmed, null. 2028 is the SMM target for full capacity; the topping-out article gives no production start date.

Foshan (Nanhai district) base: signed with Nanhai government 2021-03-31 as a 30 GWh project (MarkLines headline only, body paywalled). REPT's 2025 ESG coverage lists Foshan among four operating production bases (S8), and REPT said in Jan 2023 that the Foshan base was under construction (shifair, quote not stored). No source gives Foshan's installed capacity, start year, chemistry or format. Plausibility check: Wenzhou 50 + Jiashan 32 built + Liuzhou 20 + Foshan 30 would exceed the company's 90 GWh designed capacity at end-2025 (S1), so Foshan and/or Liuzhou are only partly built; installed left null. ref_year 2021 = fallback, searched (year of the source stating the plan). 30 GWh is a 2021 plan figure that may have been scaled back. See ESCALATE.

rows.notes: v1 'Jiaxing plant' is REPT's Jiashan (嘉善, Jiaxing prefecture) base operated by subsidiary Shanghai Lanjun New Energy (兰钧新能源); Jiaxing itself is only an R&D location in REPT's 2025 reports (AR p.16 and NBD ESG article), and Jiashan is named as a production base (S8). Phases: 一期 16 GWh (in production from 2022 per search summaries of MarkLines, not stored) + 二期 16 GWh (construction completed Jan 2024) + 三期 45 GWh under construction = 77 GWh total (S7; 16+16+45 = 77 checked). installed 32 is derived from S7 (77 total minus 45 under construction; phases 1-2 'built', not explicitly 'producing'), as of the article date. ref_year 2024 = fallback, searched (no phase-3 date found; newest source is June 2024, so phase-3 status unknown and the 77 GWh may be stale). Cross-check: Wenzhou 50 + Jiashan 77 would be 127 GWh, well above REPT's 90 GWh designed capacity at end-2025 (S1), so phase 3 cannot be complete. Coordinates remain the Jiaxing city centroid placeholder from v1, not Jiashan town. Row id kept; plant_name corrected.

Liuzhou Liudong New Area base: Oct 2022 groundbreaking of the SAIC-Tsingshan joint venture base, 20 GWh/yr per year, RMB 10bn, two JVs (cells and packs) (EnergyTrend; local media said the figure could be revised). EnergyTrend does not mention REPT; the link to REPT's Liuzhou base rests on REPT naming Liuzhou among its 2025 production bases (S8), its HK IPO proceeds naming Liuzhou (EnergyTrend 2023 piece, not stored) and the Tsingshan-SAIC JV structure also seen for Chongqing (S15). Status operational from the 2025 ESG coverage (S8: base ran 54 emergency drills in 2025). No GWh installed, start year or chemistry found. ref_year 2022 = fallback, searched (plan year). jv_partners SAIC Motor per the JV announcement; ownership split not found. See ESCALATE.

REPT headquarters base in Wenzhou Economic and Technology Development Zone. Phases: 一期+二期 about 26 GWh built (stated in a 2023 MarkLines item, paywalled, not stored; implied by S6: 50 total minus 24) + 三期 24 GWh (planned capacity 24 GWh lithium batteries and systems, S6 and S16) = 50 GWh. Phase III factory passed completion acceptance (竣工验收) in Jul 2025 (S6), so ref_year 2025; whether phase-III lines are producing is not stated (v1 had operational, 50, ref 2025 without sources; now sourced). installed left null because the company reports capacity only as a group total (90 GWh designed at end-2025, S1). Operational status from REPT's 2025 ESG coverage naming Wenzhou a production base (S8). chemistry mixed and end_market mixed are group-level statements (LFP and ternary cells, EV and ESS, S4/S5), not Wenzhou-specific; cell_format not stated, null. start_year nulled (v1 timeline's Jan 2019 first line not re-confirmed).
